title: Receiving items with confidence
lede: All eight receiving-flow findings addressed: clearer setup, recoverable receiving, and usable next steps.

sections.heading: Creation choices and product details
sections.note: Matched dirty-source snapshots and identical empty-draft fixture settings. Desktop/tablet are the primary web workflow; phone width is smoke coverage.

changes.was: Interrupted stock changes could be applied again, and refresh lost receiving context.
changes.now: Actor/body-bound transaction receipts replay committed results. Browser drafts retain identities, shipment details, partial handoffs and failed images; files must be reattached.

changes.was: Attachment choice was buried; numbered families started empty and could not receive into an existing family here.
changes.now: Parent choice is upfront. Receive into an existing numbered family, default to one unit, or explicitly create an empty family.

changes.was: Photos were less visible and failed-image recovery only retried the same source.
changes.now: Review product details and photos directly, reject unrelated model/accessory suggestions, replace failed photos, and print or download labels after receiving.

verification: 78 focused tests passed; TypeScript, scoped lint, application build and docs checks passed.

Two tests against an isolated disposable PostgreSQL cluster proved concurrent identical requests change stock once and receipt failures roll stock back. This is local database proof, not hosted inventory acceptance.

Actual component fixtures checked lost responses, malformed successes, partial batch refresh/replay, new shipments, draft discard, existing-family units, upfront parent choice and failed-photo replacement.

Authenticated isolated ADMIN preview at 1280 and 768px restored product/batch drafts, kept row identities unique, loaded existing families, and exposed the upfront parent picker. No inventory mutations or page errors.
notes: Recovery screenshots: partial-handoff.png and failed-photo.png (after-only fixtures). Authenticated draft screenshots: authenticated-draft-1280.png and authenticated-draft-768.png.
The saved Brave key remains invalid. Automatic photo matching has fixture proof; live provider acceptance remains open. Keyless B&H search, pasted photo and upload remain available.
No commit, deployment, native changes, or production persistence claim.
